department: Blizard Institute (Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry)

deadline.value: Medicine and dentistry studentships are advertised per project. The Blizard Institute advertises most of them in the autumn term.
deadline.quote: Medicine and Dentistry studentships: various (please check the advert for project)

also.quote: The Blizard Institute is able to offer a range of studentships throughout the year, although a large proportion are advertised during the autumn term.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject requirement is mentioned on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: Contact a prospective supervisor by email with your CV and details of how you will fund the research.
supervisor.quote: When reaching out to a prospective supervisor via email please include your CV and details of any funding you are planning on applying for to pay for your research.

funding.value: Studentships come from research councils, charities and the university or medical school, and are limited. Applicants must show they can pay tuition.
funding.quote: These include funding from research councils, charities, and our own Queen Mary and medical school studentships.

also.quote: Applicants will also need to demonstrate that they have adequate funding to cover the tuition fees for the duration of their study.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a first or upper second-class degree, or a master's in a relevant subject from a UK university.
entry_route.quote: a first or upper second class degree OR a masters degree in a relevant subject from a UK university

notes: Covers the Blizard Institute non-clinical PhD. Neuroscience is one of the institute's centres, so no separate neuroscience PhD is saved. Barts Cancer Institute and the William Harvey Research Institute also run PhDs; they use the same Band 4 English rule and are not saved separately.
name: Blizard Institute non-clinical PhD
